channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county. item.title: Murray Middle School demolition begins in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition crews are tearing down damaged buildings at Murray Middle School in Martin County, marking the start of a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage caused by Hurricane Milton. The project includes reconstruction of buildings destroyed in the tornadoes, along with a new administ

item.title: JetBlue ends Vero Beach to New York JFK route after nine months, citing low demand
item.description: JetBlue is ending direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport on Sept. 9, just nine months after the route began operating in December.

item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks foster families during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers rates 5.6% for Florida homeowners, adds disappearing deductible
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6%, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Lantana Finland House celebrates Panthers' four Finnish stars
item.description: The Finland Club in Lantana has become a hockey hotspot thanks to four Finnish players on the Florida Panthers roster, including captain Aleksander Barkov.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts qualify for Junior Olympics with top 15 national finish
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee, and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month.

item.title: Miami Heat introduce Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis Jr. at Kaseya Center
item.description: The Miami Heat introduced two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and forward Bobby Portis Jr. on Thursday afternoon to loud chants at Kaseya Center.

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season on road before home opener against Minnesota Wild
item.description: The Panthers will start their regular season campaign on the road against four Western Conference opponents before returning to Amerant Bank Arena on Oct. 11.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two late goals to defeat England 2-1 on Wednesday, advancing to the World Cup final where they will face Spain on Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: Spain defeats France 2-0 to reach World Cup final
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro scored as Spain advanced to its first World Cup final since winning in 2010 with a 2-0 victory over France on Tuesday.

item.title: Okeeheelee All-Stars make history with scoreless run, head to Southeast Regionals
item.description: The Okeeheelee Comanches 10U All-Stars have accomplished something unprecedented in their program's history, allowing zero runs during district and state tournament play. item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa discounts
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched the Downtown Delray Wellness Pass for July and August. The mobile-exclusive pass allows users to access complimentary classes, discounted wellness treatments and promotions from participating businesses.

item.title: John Brewster Music performs Thankful Thursdays at Hudsons on Treasure Coast
item.description: John Brewster Music is performing at Thankful Thursdays at Hudsons, offering live music entertainment for Treasure Coast residents.

item.title: Treasure Coast weekend events offer activities for local residents
item.description: Multiple events are scheduled across the Treasure Coast this weekend, providing entertainment and activity options for residents in Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The nonprofit in Lake Worth Beach supports more than 35 Summer BreakSpot sites across Palm Beach County, serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children while school is out.

item.title: Donalds and Jolly lead Florida governor's race as primary enters final stretch
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly have emerged as frontrunners in Florida's gubernatorial race as the August 18 primary approaches. item.title: Security First Insurance cuts Florida homeowners rates by 5.6%
item.description: The Ormond Beach-based insurer announced new discounts and a disappearing deductible program as companies cite reduced lawsuits from state reforms.

item.title: Ballot challenge threatens to exclude votes for Florida gubernatorial candidate Fishback
item.description: A hearing beginning July 21 will determine whether businessman James Fishback meets Florida's seven-year residency requirement for governor.

item.title: Attack ad targets Florida gubernatorial candidate Fishback over alleged antisemitic statements
item.description: The Front Line, a Republican group aligned with U.S. Sen. Ted Cruz, announced a $400,000 campaign against businessman James Fishback.

item.title: Democratic gubernatorial candidate Jolly addresses ties to indicted Clearwater financier
item.description: David Jolly responded to questions about his past business and political relationship with Leo Govoni, who federal prosecutors allege stole more than $100 million.

item.title: Gov. DeSantis remains neutral in Florida Republican gubernatorial primary
item.description: The governor has not endorsed Lt. Gov. Jay Collins, whom he appointed in August 2025, or any other candidate in the race.

item.title: Florida homeowners pay highest average insurance premium in nation
item.description: Online firm Insurify reports that in 2026 Florida homeowners pay an average premium of $8,292, the highest in the country.

item.title: Palm City WPTV Weather Spotter with Navy background discusses decades of forecasting evolution
item.description: A Palm City WPTV Weather Spotter with a lifelong passion for meteorology spoke with WPTV First Alert Weather Meteorologist James Wieland about how weather forecasting has evolved over the decades.
